overview_description.description:
Onshape is a product development platform that unites CAD, data management, collaboration tools, and real-time analytics. Its modern CAD system eliminates design gridlock so professional engineers can do their best work. Onshape unites advanced modeling tools and design data management in a secure cloud workspace that is accessible on any device and never loses data. 

Professional engineers at thousands of companies rely on Onshape to modernize their design process. Onshape users have logged over 3 million hours modeling advanced robotics, biomedical devices, industrial machinery, and myriad other products.

Founded in 2012 by the creators of SOLIDWORKS, Onshape has raised $169 million from Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, North Bridge, and other leading investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Onshape is a product development platform that unites CAD, data management, collaboration tools, and real-time analytics.

product.name: Onshape Cloud-Native CAD
product.description: A cloud-based 3D CAD system for designing parts, assemblies, sheet metal, and frames with parametric modeling and surfacing capabilities.

product.name: Onshape Built-in Product Data Management (PDM)
product.description: An integrated data management system that centralizes design data, tracks versions, manages bill of materials, and supports branching and merging workflows.

product.name: Onshape Simulation
product.description: A cloud-based simulation tool for performing linear static and modal analyses to evaluate stress, deformation, and natural frequencies of assemblies.

product.name: Onshape CAM Studio
product.description: A cloud-native computer-aided manufacturing tool for planning, visualizing, and simulating CNC machining processes from 2.5 to 5-axis operations.

product.name: Onshape PCB Studio
product.description: A tool that connects electronic CAD (ECAD) data with mechanical CAD (MCAD) designs to facilitate integrated product development of electronics and enclosures.

product.name: Onshape Render Studio
product.description: A photorealistic rendering tool that creates high-quality visualizations of CAD models with realistic materials, textures, and lighting in a web browser.
